The stories become less isolated, yet each episode has its own flavor, and hopefully we're bringing a lot more scope to the show.|Jon Favreau on Season Two|}} '''''The Mandalorian'' Season Two''' is the second season of the American web television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. Then I'll cite examples from the movies, or ''Clone Wars'', to try to use as a justification. I'm like a lawyer talking to a judge; I am to him as he was to George. I won't do anything without Dave's approval. And to his credit, he understands that ''Star Wars'' needs to be fun and ever-evolving.|Jon Favreau|}} In [[July]] [[2019]], showrunner [[Jon Favreau]] stated that he had started writing the show's second season, and pre-production was underway. As he told ''[[Entertainment Weekly]]'', his writing influenced by [[Wikipedia:Game of Thrones|''Game of Thrones'']] format of telling multiple storylines at the same time. Favreau also returned as a director, alongside cast member [[Carl Weathers]] and [[The Mandalorian Season One|season one]] directors [[Dave Filoni]], [[Rick Famuyiwa]] and [[Bryce Dallas Howard]], as well as newcomers [[Peyton Reed]] and [[Robert Rodriguez]], new directors to the show. With less startup costs than the first season, more of the budget was used for the show itself. [[George Lucas]] again visited the set, and gave Filoni tips on directing. The season finished filming a few days before the March 2020 [[Wikipedia:COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 pandemic]]. The post-production team had to adapt to the quarantine, with their biggest trouble being the recording of the musical score. ==Release== On [[September 8]], [[2020]], [[Entertainment Weekly]] revealed the first promotional images from the season. The first trailer was released on [[September 15]],{{SWYouTube|eW7Twd85m2g|The Mandalorian | Season 2 Official Trailer | Disney+}} followed by a special "sneak peak" during halftime of [[Wikipedia:Monday Night Football|Monday Night Football]] on [[October 19]].{{Twitter|disneyplus|status/1317480488567668737|[[Disney+]]|quote=Don't miss an exclusive look at the new season of #TheMandalorian during @ESPN Monday Night Football!
